title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
lineage: Master Cassette -> 24bit/96kHz wav -> slight edit (fade-in, out, azimuth adjustment, and slight level changes for crowd noise) -> 16-bit, 44.1 khz wav (triangular noise dither)
source: Unknown Mic, Unknown Cassette recorder (mono)  Location:  Slightly too close to stage

ai_review.summary: Partial audience tape with clearer sound than other circulations, but the limited song count leaves it a mixed experience.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this audience recording as sounding better than other circulating tapes, calling it a great capture when it does play. However, they lament that only a few songs are present and that key moments (the "caught" interaction) are missing, resulting in an overall mixed impression of the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Two moderate‑rating (3‑star) reviews highlight decent audio quality but note significant missing content, leading to an average overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as superior to other audience tapes in circulation; clear enough to be enjoyable, though only a fragment of the concert is captured.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial recording prevents full assessment; reviewers note missing songs and an omitted "caught" interaction that would have added interest.
